strings.d1.s0.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
strings.d1.s0.tips: White marble mosque with 82 domes and the world's largest carpet. Free entry, register online, abayas provided. Closed Friday midday. Magical at sunset.
strings.d1.s1.name: Wahat Al Karama
strings.d1.s1.tips: Martyrs' memorial made of aluminium panels, with a reflection of the mosque.
strings.d1.s2.name: Qasr Al Watan
strings.d1.s2.tips: The presidential palace: Great Hall dome, library and an evening light show (Palace in Motion).
strings.d1.s3.name: Emirates Palace Le Café
strings.d1.s3.tips: Gold-leaf cappuccino and camel milk with dates in the famous "palace" hotel.
strings.d1.s4.name: Corniche
strings.d1.s4.tips: 8 km of waterfront: sunset walk, beach (flagged area 10 AED) and cycling.
strings.d1.b0.name: Al Mrzab Emirati
strings.d1.b0.tips: Bib Gourmand Emirati restaurant; try machboos (spiced rice with meat) and luqaimat (sweet dumplings).
strings.d1.b1.name: Founder's Memorial
strings.d1.b1.tips: 3D portrait of Sheikh Zayed (Constellation), lit up at night. An alternative to the Corniche.
strings.d2.s0.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
strings.d2.s0.tips: Jean Nouvel's "rain of light" dome. A universal museum with Da Vinci's La Belle Ferronnière. Closed Monday, book tickets online, boat tour extra.
strings.d2.s1.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi Café
strings.d2.s2.name: Abrahamic Family House
strings.d2.s2.tips: A mosque, church and synagogue side by side. Free registration.
strings.d2.s3.name: Saadiyat Beach Club
strings.d2.s3.tips: Best after sunset in summer, when the sea is 35°C.
strings.d2.b0.name: Fouquet's Abu Dhabi
strings.d2.b0.tips: French brasserie inside the Louvre, with a view of the dome.
strings.d2.b1.name: Soul Beach Saadiyat
strings.d2.b1.tips: Public beach; a cheaper option than the club.
strings.d3.s0.name: Ferrari World Abu Dhabi
strings.d3.s0.tips: Home of Formula Rossa, the world's fastest roller coaster (240 km/h). Indoors and air-conditioned. Book online (combined ticket with Yas parks).
strings.d3.s1.name: Yas Mall Food Court
strings.d3.s1.tips: Lunch break; return with your park ticket (until 16:00).
strings.d3.s2.name: Yas Marina Circuit
strings.d3.s2.tips: F1 track. Cycling and walking are free in the evening, Tuesday to Sunday. Yas Viceroy hotel.
strings.d3.s3.name: Yas Bay Waterfront
strings.d3.s3.tips: Waterside restaurants and Etihad Arena; go in the evening.
strings.d3.b0.name: Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi
strings.d3.b0.tips: Indoor cartoon theme park; an alternative to Ferrari World (with children).
strings.d3.b1.name: Cipriani Yas Island
strings.d3.b1.tips: Italian restaurant over the marina; a smarter alternative to Yas Bay.
strings.d4.s0.name: Al Ain Oasis
strings.d4.s0.tips: UNESCO site with 147,000 date palms and falaj irrigation channels. 1.5 hours by car or bus; shaded paths.
strings.d4.s1.name: Al Jahili Fort
strings.d4.s1.tips: Fort from 1891 with a Wilfred Thesiger photography exhibition. Free.
strings.d4.s2.name: Al Ain Palace Museum
strings.d4.s2.tips: Sheikh Zayed's former palace; explore the rooms.
strings.d4.s3.name: Al Fanar Al Ain
strings.d4.s3.tips: 1960s Emirati decor; try machboos and harees (wheat and meat porridge).
strings.d4.s4.name: Jebel Hafeet
strings.d4.s4.tips: A 1,240 m mountain road, among the world's best drives. Sunset at the summit with views of the desert and Oman.
strings.d4.b0.name: Al Ain Camel Market
strings.d4.b0.tips: Camel market, lively in the morning. An alternative to the palace.
strings.d4.b1.name: Mercure Jebel Hafeet Café
strings.d4.b1.tips: Hilltop hotel terrace for tea and views.
strings.d5.s0.name: Eastern Mangroves Kayak
strings.d5.s0.tips: Kayak through the mangrove forest in the city. Flamingos and herons; cool in the morning.
strings.d5.s1.name: Qasr Al Hosn
strings.d5.s1.tips: Abu Dhabi's oldest building (1795 tower) and a good introduction to the city's history. Next to the Cultural Foundation.
strings.d5.s2.name: Al Mina Fish Market Lunch
strings.d5.s2.tips: Harbour market: pick your fish and have it cooked at the restaurant next door.
strings.d5.s3.name: Desert Safari Al Khatim
strings.d5.s3.tips: Dune bashing (4x4), camel rides and sandboarding. Sunset and camp.
strings.d5.s4.name: Desert Camp Dinner
strings.d5.s4.tips: BBQ buffet, shisha, henna and tanoura dance; included in the tour.
strings.d5.b0.name: Cultural Foundation Abu Dhabi
strings.d5.b0.tips: Exhibitions and a library, next to Qasr Al Hosn.
strings.d5.b1.name: Meylas Al Muneera
strings.d5.b1.tips: Emirati breakfast and lunch; try balaleet (sweet vermicelli with eggs).
strings.d6.s0.name: Heritage Village
strings.d6.s0.tips: Reconstructed Bedouin village with craftspeople, next to Marina Mall. Free.
strings.d6.s1.name: Etihad Towers Observation Deck at 300
strings.d6.s1.tips: 300 m up on the 74th floor; tea included, with views of Emirates Palace and the Corniche.
strings.d6.s2.name: Al Bateen Dhow Yard
strings.d6.s2.tips: Traditional wooden dhows being built at Al Bateen harbour.
strings.d6.s3.name: Erth Restaurant
strings.d6.s3.tips: Michelin-starred modern Emirati cuisine, next to Qasr Al Hosn. Reservation needed.
strings.d6.s4.name: Umm Al Emarat Park
strings.d6.s4.tips: City park with a shaded greenhouse and a petting zoo.
strings.d6.b0.name: Al Bateen Beach
strings.d6.b0.tips: Quiet city beach; an alternative to the park.
strings.d6.b1.name: Li Beirut Jumeirah Etihad Towers
strings.d7.theme: Souk morning and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: World Trade Center Souk
strings.d7.s0.tips: Foster's modern take on the souk: spices, dates and oud for souvenirs.
strings.d7.s1.name: Al Hosn Coffee Break
strings.d7.s1.tips: Arabic coffee and dates; a farewell treat.
strings.d7.s2.name: Jubail Mangrove Park Boardwalk
strings.d7.s2.tips: 2 km mangrove boardwalk on the road to Saadiyat, 20 minutes from the airport.
strings.d7.s3.name: Abu Dhabi Zayed International Airport
strings.d7.b0.name: Cafe Arabia Al Bateen
strings.d7.b1.name: Mushrif Central Park
strings.d7.b1.tips: City park; an alternative to the mangroves.
strings.note0: Taxis (Careem/Uber) are the main way to get around. Buses are cheap with a Hafilat card. The E100 bus to Dubai takes 1.5 hours (25 AED). The airport is 30 minutes away.
strings.note1: SUMMER is 42-45°C and humid: do NOT go out between 11:00 and 16:00. Do the mosque and mangroves from 8:00 to 10:00, the Louvre or Ferrari World (indoors) at midday and the Corniche in the evening. Check Ramadan dates.
strings.note2: The mosque is free (registration, abaya). Louvre 63, Qasr 65, Ferrari 345, safari 250-350. Tip 10%. Alcohol only in hotels and licensed venues.
strings.note3: Dress: shoulders and knees covered in malls and at the mosque. The mosque is closed on Friday midday and the Louvre on Monday. Ferrari World is cheaper with an online combined ticket.
strings.note4: Turkish citizens get 90 days visa-free. Cards are accepted everywhere. The weekend is Friday and Saturday.
strings.note5: Emirati dishes: machboos, harees, luqaimat and camel milk. Try Al Fanar, Meylas, Al Mrzab and Erth.
